title: Smew
blurb: The smew is a species of duck and is the only living member of the genus Mergellus. The genus is closely related to Mergus and is sometimes included in it; genetic studies have shown that it is the sister taxon to Mergus and Lophodytes.
facts: The smew has hybridised with the common goldeneye.
